Actions.Button: Primary, secondary, quiet, disabled and loading actions.
Actions.IconButton: Named icon-only actions with a 48px target.
Actions.Link: Native anchors with visible underlines and safe new-tab defaults.

Forms and selection.TextField: Labeled single-line input with descriptions and errors.
Forms and selection.Textarea: Multiline text entry with native resizing and validation messages.
Forms and selection.NumberField: Bounded numeric entry with increment/decrement controls.
Forms and selection.Combobox: Searchable choice list with label filtering and empty results.
Forms and selection.MultiSelect: Controlled searchable multiple choices with removable selections and native form values.
Forms and selection.RadioGroup: Exclusive choice with optional option descriptions.
Forms and selection.ToggleGroup: Single/multiple toggles with horizontal and vertical layouts.
Forms and selection.Slider: Controlled single numeric value with keyboard adjustment.
Forms and selection.DateField: Native date entry; calendar presentation follows the browser.
Forms and selection.Calendar: Inline Gregorian date selection with keyboard navigation, inclusive bounds and unavailable days.
Forms and selection.DatePicker: Single ISO date selection in a labeled calendar popup, with clear action and form values.
Forms and selection.DateRangePicker: Start/end ISO date selection with incomplete-range guidance and unavailable-day exclusions.
Forms and selection.FileUpload: Native file selection with accept/multiple support; upload transport is owned by the application.

Navigation and data.Tabs: Controlled tab navigation with preserved panel state.
Navigation and data.Breadcrumbs: Linked hierarchy with an explicit current destination.
Navigation and data.Pagination: Controlled pages with bounded navigation and compact long ranges.
Navigation and data.DataTable: Semantic table, client-side sorting, empty/loading states; compose pagination externally.

Overlays and disclosure.Tooltip: Short supplementary help on a focusable trigger.
Overlays and disclosure.DropdownMenu: Keyboard action menu with disabled items.
Overlays and disclosure.CommandPalette: Searchable action dialog with keyboard selection, disabled actions and controlled opening.
Overlays and disclosure.Dialog: Modal content with focus containment and return.
Overlays and disclosure.AlertDialog: Destructive confirmation with initial focus on cancellation.
Overlays and disclosure.Drawer: Modal side panel with named close action.

Feedback and display.Alert: Inline feedback with optional polite/assertive announcements.
Feedback and display.Badge: Short textual status with restrained semantic colour.
Feedback and display.Avatar: Image or initials with an accessible name and failed-image fallback.
Feedback and display.Skeleton: Decorative placeholder with optional screen-reader loading text.
Feedback and display.Spinner: Visible loading text with reduced-motion-aware icon.
Feedback and display.EmptyState: Empty content explanation with an optional real action.
Feedback and display.StatusIcon: Decorative async state icon; always pair with meaningful text.
Feedback and display.ToastProvider: Notification queue and live announcements, used with useToast.
